faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Book Trust India (NBT) for filling up vacant posts in New Delhi under the Government sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in NBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Young Professional - PR. Candidates fulfilling the required educational qualifications are eligible to submit their applications online.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Young Professional - PR position as per the official notification issued by the National Book Trust India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for NBT Young Professional - PR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 13-10-2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this date to avoid last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional - PR post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate/Master Degree in Mass Communications/Public Relations/Journalism/Advertising/Media or any in related field to be eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NBT Young Professional - PR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Candidates should verify their age eligibility against the official guidelines before applying.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional - PR position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50000 to Rs. 70000, ensuring a well-paid and stable government contract opportunity.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to NBT Young Professional - PR posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee for all categories is Nil.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for NBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Candidates must visit the official website or use the provided direct links to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF for NBT Young Professional - PR?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by clicking the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this recruitment article.
